import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import resource

# 8 lines, each near the maximum query-token budget
lines = []
for i in range(8):
    services = ["svc%02d" % j for j in range(24)]
    rules = [
        {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": ["svc00", "svc01"]}},
        {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": ["svc05", "svc06", "svc07"]}},
        {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "endswith", "path": ["svc23"]}},
        {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["svc00", "svc01", "svc02"]}},
    ]
    queries = []
    for q in range(256):
        queries.append([services[(q + j) % 24] for j in range(64)])
    lines.append(json.dumps({"services": services, "rules": rules, "queries": queries}))
payload = ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode()
print("input bytes:", len(payload))
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                   capture_output=True, timeout=300)
el = time.time() - t0
usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print("rc=%d time=%.2fs stdout=%d bytes maxrss=%d KB" % (p.returncode, el, len(p.stdout), usage.ru_maxrss))
if p.stderr:
    print("stderr:", p.stderr.decode()[:1000])
outs = [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
print("lines:", len(outs), "states:", [len(o["dfa"]["accept"]) for o in outs])
PYEOF
